Do not paste personal dictation history, recordings, tokens or private machine details. Use made-up examples.

## What would this help you do?

Describe the task, the difficulty today and the result you want.

## Which roadmap stage does it serve?

See the [north star](https://github.com/noamlittvock/dictator/blob/main/docs/vision.md). Choose one and explain why:

- [ ] Command — dictation, voice launch and workspace routines on your Macs (available now).
- [ ] Supervise — what ran, agents reporting back, “needs you” signals and returning to the right place (next).
- [ ] Delegate — ordinary-language requests, the simplest reliable mechanism, agents where reasoning is needed, within chosen permissions (later).

## Proposed behaviour

Give a made-up example. What would the user choose, see and control? If this touches private data or permissions, explain the opt-in choice.

## Alternatives

What can you do today, and what other approach might work?
